headline: IFC Partners with Access Holdings to Expand African Trade Finance
summary: Access Holdings and the International Finance Corporation signed an agreement to expand trade finance capacity and support regional and international market access for African enterprises.
why: Access Holdings is one of Africa's largest banking conglomerates, and the IFC is the commercial development arm of the World Bank Group.

impacts.name: Access Holdings Plc
impacts.why: Partnering with the IFC enhances Access Group's balance sheet capacity for cross-border trade funding.
